digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend port / vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import adapters.jira for scalar concerns (project scoping, environment validation, assignee error handling) violating vendor neutrality requirements
Backend Protocol must expose read-only scalar members (project, query_project) and assert_env_ready() without vendor-specific parameterization to break the dependency chain
Nested lazy imports in function bodies require full-tree AST validation rather than top-level-only inspection to ensure complete vendor decoupling
JiraBackend implementation must preserve existing fail-closed/fail-fast semantics (DIG default in applier, un-defaulted fetcher, JIRA_* attestation) while delegating through the backend abstraction
